text:
DeployBot: [ALERT] regional error burst detected during rollout v4.0.0 -> us-west-2 nodes 10/12 showing elevated p99 and intermittent 5xx. Suggested action: pause rollout + consider region-specific revert to v3.9.8. (alert RWD-1300)
Mia Eng: grabbing logs now, can someone scope whether dedicated pools hit?
Omar SRE: dedicated customers unaffected so far (only public canary and early staging traffic). error trace: `exec_kernel: kernel_select failed -> fallback missing` across several GPU types.
Priya PM: ok product note: we should avoid a global revert unless customers are impacted. prefer regional containment if safe.
Kate Ops: do we want DeployBot to auto-revert the region or perform a manual rollback? change window is open for another 1h 20m.
Mia Eng: manual region revert pls. I'd like to pin us-west-2 to 3.9.8, keep other regions on v4.0.0 paused for now.
DeployBot: available commands:
```
/deploy pause --rollout=v4.0.0 --scope=global
/deploy revert --region=us-west-2 --to=3.9.8 --ticket=RWD-1300 --reason="kernel-select-failure"
/route pin --region=us-west-2 --model=3.9.8 --note="post-revert-pin"
```
Kate Ops: executing pause now.
DeployBot: Rollout paused globally. No new traffic will be shifted.
Kate Ops: running region revert command now:
```
/deploy revert --region=us-west-2 --to=3.9.8 --ticket=RWD-1300 --reason="kernel-select-failure"
```
DeployBot: Revert started for us-west-2. Progress: 4/12 nodes done. ETA 6m.
Omar SRE: monitoring shows error-rate dropping on reverted nodes. p99 trending back to baseline for those.
Priya PM: drafting customer-facing blurb: "We paused a rollout and reverted a regional slice due to increased errors. No dedicated customers affected. We're investigating and will update when we have a fix." Thoughts?
Mia Eng: add link to engineering note and include short technical root-cause note: kernel selection regressed for quantized path; gating flag didn't trigger fallback.
Kate Ops: once revert completes I'll pin the region to 3.9.8 and open a freeze on further rollouts until postmortem. Command: `/route pin --region=us-west-2 --model=3.9.8 --reason=post-revert`
DeployBot: Revert complete for us-west-2. 12/12 nodes running 3.9.8. Pin recommended. Auto-safety rollback disabled for this rollout until manual review.
Oncall Bot: Incident created: RWD-1300. Participants: Omar SRE, Mia Eng, Kate Ops.
Omar SRE: creating internal ticket PM-ROLL-1820004321 for timeline + logs.
Priya PM: posting status page draft at status.redwood.ai/incidents/RWD-1300-draft. tagging legal for sign-off.
Mia Eng: I'll branch a hotfix (hotfix/usw2-kernel-guard) and run the full regression suite against a pinned canary in staging. ETA 3h.
Kate Ops: follow-ups: (1) notify Dedicated accounts in us-west-2 (if any) with a brief note, (2) update release notes to mark v4.0.0 paused and record region-level revert, (3) schedule postmortem.
Omar SRE: monitoring window 30m then handoff to Eng for verification.
Priya PM: thanks team 44d kept scope small and comms clear.
DeployBot: Note: global rollback not executed. Region-level containment performed. Manual pin and postmortem required per policy.
